title: Map prepositional phrases
subtitle: Attach each phrase to the word it modifies.
overview: A prepositional phrase can modify an action, a noun phrase, or an entire assertion. Case and local position help, but meaning decides the final attachment.
Bracket the phrase, identify its object and case, then draw an arrow to the word or clause it most naturally qualifies.

sections.title: Attachment questions
